entry.note: Verified via Crossref REST API (DOI 10.2140/pjm.1996.174.431) and MSP open-access full text.

relevance.rationale: Original theorem identifying Wada's twisted Alexander polynomial of a knot exterior with Reidemeister torsion for acyclic SL_n-representations (complementing kitano-twisted-alexander, which holds Dubois-Yamaguchi 2012).

keyResults.statement: Wada's twisted Alexander polynomial A_{K,rho}(t) equals the Reidemeister torsion tau(E_K; rho tensor alpha) and is symmetric up to t^{mn} when rho factors through SO(n).
keyResults.useForFolio: Bridges polynomial Fox-calculus twisted Alexander invariants to combinatorial Reidemeister torsion.

proposedActions.rationale: Registered to complete the Kitano (1996) primary source alongside kitano-twisted-alexander.
